title: L1: independent cross-review of lag drafts #343 and #344
public_pr_body:
Independently checks #343 findings and #344 implementation against 9c3f5c6. No production mistake found; adds actual CSV/Excel getter parity and the real default 20,000-row boundary cases. Traces Word/PDF and separate worksheet/print reads, smaller-cap pagination and hidden-tab polling.

Validation: 42 focused tests pass across four files, no failures/skips; changed-test ESLint and whitespace checks pass. Four unchanged snapshots also match the untouched candidate (selective baseline run). No full-suite/runtime/latency proof claimed.

Handover: docs/handover/BUILDER-6-L1.md. Follow-up targets builder 4's branch; original branches untouched. Draft only; no main merge, production SQL, deployment or Ready label.
